subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What degraded-state contract should Gateway and Control UI expose while plugin/config reload or launchd restart recovery makes the runtime only partially trustworthy?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Gateway readiness semantics, session RPC errors, WebChat/Control UI UX, and restart recovery; automation cannot safely choose whether to fail closed, keep partial liveness, or scope only the WebChat notice subset.

options.title: Define Shared Degraded RPC/UI Contract
options.body: Return a retryable degraded/unavailable state for affected session/chat RPCs and surface the same state in Control UI until the runtime is trustworthy again.

options.title: Land Narrow Notice Fix First
options.body: Treat #95154 as a subset improvement for WebChat restart notices while leaving this broader launchd partial-reload issue open.

options.title: Limit To Operator Guidance
options.body: Document live plugin/config maintenance as disruptive and avoid a broader runtime readiness contract for now.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Degraded RPC/UI Contract
recommendation.body: Return a retryable degraded/unavailable state for affected session/chat RPCs and surface the same state in Control UI until the runtime is trustworthy again.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points most strongly to broad Gateway reload, restart, and service handoff ownership.
